tl.d: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.
Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.
Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.
Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 6%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.
Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.
Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.
Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.
Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 15%.
Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 10%.

Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing [32 / Ferocity: 48 / Unleashed Fury: 52 + (Ranged Attack Power * (0.05))] Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.
Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.
Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 20% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Gives your pet a 100% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.
Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.
Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.
Gives your Concussive Shot a 20% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 5%.
Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.
Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.
Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.
You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.
Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yds by 30.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.
Hitting a target with your Serpent Sting ability grants you 50% and consuming Rapid Killing grants you 100% of your Mana regeneration while casting for the next 15 sec.
Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 10%.
A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.
Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.
A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 160 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.
While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.
Increases your Parry chance by 5%.
When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.
Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 4%.
Increases your total Health by 10%.
Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.
Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.
Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.
When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.
Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 10%.
Increases your melee critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.

A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Reduces the mana cost of your Trap abilities and melee abilities by 60%. In addition, your critical strikes have a 60% chance to allow 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.
Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 10 sec.
Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.
A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.
Increases your Agility by 10%.
Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec

a.d: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.
A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 70.
Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
Stings the target, causing 555 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
An instant shot that causes 217 Arcane damage.

Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 71. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.
Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.
The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 120. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
Summons your pet to you.
Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.
Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.
Stamina increased by 40.
Armor increased by 1000.
Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.
Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
Distract the target, causing threat.
Heals your pet 245 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.
Inflicts 50 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 60% for 10 sec.
Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.
Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min.
Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.
Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 690 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.
Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 57. Can only be performed after you dodge.
Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.
Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 166. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.
Increases Arcane resistance by 120.
The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. Disables auto-attack.
Increases Fire resistance by 120.

Place a Frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.
Increases Frost resistance by 120.
Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.
Increases Nature resistance by 120.
Increases Shadow resistance by 120.
Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
Gather information about the target beast. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.
Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.
Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.
You take on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 110. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 110 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 6 min. If not cancelled, after 6 min you will actually die.
Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 451 damage over 21 sec.
Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.
Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yards by 50. Lasts 30 min.

Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 208 to 264 Fire damage and 330 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing [108 + (Ranged Attack Power * (0.05))] Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
Stings the target, draining 1108 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 112 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.
The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 60. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 295 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.
Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.
